about: Exceptions for scripts/security/secret-scan.mjs. A secret-rule entry only lets through values that look fake (fixture markers, a few distinct characters, a PEM body of a few bytes); a real key in the same file is still reported. Each entry needs a reason.

entries.reason: Service-account fixture whose PEM body is 4 characters, so it cannot be a key.
Scanner tests feed fake secrets and fake client data to the scanner; secret rules still require the value to look fake.
Service-account-shaped fixture for the env quoting round trip; the PEM body is a few fake bytes.
Fake prod env values for the env-sync override tests; secret rules still require the value to look fake.

commitEntriesAbout: Each entry lets one finding through in one past commit only (exact sha, path, line and rule). It never covers a value from a local .env file or a retired secret, and the scan lists every finding it lets through.

commitEntries.reason: Made-up ADMIN_SECRET fixture for the env-sync tests in an intermediate commit. It matches no local .env value and no retired secret, and the next change to that file (3d8f1b6) replaced it with a fake- value.

emailsReason: Placeholder addresses only: Norwegian sample names on firma.no and an IDN sample in the LLM person-field detector tests and contract checks, a generic mailbox in the automation-settings validation test, and the owner-routing input placeholder.
